# The Long Manipulation — Narrative Script

*Audio: 07_The_Long_Manipulation.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

Three thousand six hundred years. That is how long the Shadows have been on Ge'or.

They arrived in 2989 BGD — their vessel detected human activity on the planet by chance and crashed on Erisdar. They went into hibernation. They waited.

When they woke, they found a world ripe for harvest. Species divided. Nations warring. No one remembered the Last Great War. No one remembered what the Shadows were.

They began their work quietly. A whisper in a king's ear. A famine in a rival kingdom. A war that should never have started. Every crisis looked natural. Every collapse looked like fate.

The Lumina Empire was Phase One. Baoth was Phase Two. The Erisian Church — Phase Three. By 597 AGD, the Shadows had fingers in every institution on Ge'or.

And almost no one knew they existed.
